# North Vows Photography

> Wedding, family and portrait photographer based in Kitchener, Ontario, serving Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge and clients across Canada. Natural, timeless photography led by founder and lead photographer Abin.

## Key facts
- Business: North Vows Photography
- Website: https://northvowsphotography.com/
- Location: Kitchener, ON N2E 2K2, Canada
- Service area: Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge and the rest of Canada (bookings within Canada only)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +1 (226) 989-4884
- Email: thenorthvows@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/thenorthvows
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Northvowsphotography
- Founder & lead photographer: Abin, with 5 years of experience as a destination wedding photographer

## Services
- Weddings, pre-wedding / engagement shoots and intimate functions (small weddings, elopements, anniversaries)
- Couple portraits, solo portraits, family sessions, birthday sessions and pet sessions
- Professional headshots, graduation and prom photos
- Photography, videography, or both

## Pricing (CAD, starting prices; every plan can be customised)
- Mini Sessions: from $100
- Family Sessions: from $200
- Wedding Photography: from $500
- All other events: tailor-made packages, quoted on request

## How to book
Send an enquiry through the contact form on the website (opens WhatsApp), call or WhatsApp +1 (226) 989-4884, or email thenorthvows@gmail.com.
